name: mental-board
description: An infinite canvas for your head: rich-text notes and pictures you can move, resize, link, colour and group into workflows. Every board is a folder in My Boards.
author: Ahmad <ahmedbutixr@gmail.com>

scripts.check: npm run check:lang && npm run check:icons && npm run check:crlf

scripts.test: npm run test:store && npm run test:tablet && npm run test:app
